description: Check interest rate risk in the banking book in three independent runs plus a session receipt: map non-maturity deposit balances into a bucketed net repricing gap schedule under a caller-declared behavioral allocation (ART-442), sweep the prescribed parallel shock ladder over that schedule and name the binding rung (ART-369), then run the basis-risk calculation at the binding rung cited from the ladder run (ART-443), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All balances, allocations, betas, and gaps are caller-supplied inputs; each run is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. This chain is an analytical check, not a regulatory filing and not a capital adequacy determination.
name: irrbb-nmd-shock-and-basis-risk-check
regulatory_refs: OCC 2010-1 Interagency Advisory on Interest Rate Risk
Comptroller's Handbook on Interest Rate Risk

steps.handoff: Maps caller-declared non-maturity deposit segment balances into a bucketed net repricing gap schedule using a caller-declared behavioral allocation and a deposit beta. The schedule uses the bucket keys on_1m, m1_y1, y1_y3, y3_y5, y5_y10, y10_plus, the same keys the step 2 run declares for its repricing gaps. No decay curve is supplied by this step.

Sweeps the prescribed parallel magnitudes (+100, +200, +300, +400 basis points and their negatives) over a bucketed repricing gap schedule, reporting a duration-weighted delta-EVE leg and a 12-month cumulative-gap delta-NII leg per shock, with worst_scenario naming the rung with the lowest delta-EVE. The schedule in the chain page worked example is the step 1 schedule, declared again with the same bucket keys.

Runs at the binding rung cited from the step 2 run: the step 3 run uses reference_shock_bps equal to the shock of the worst_scenario reported by the step 2 run. In the chain page worked example the step 2 run reports worst_scenario parallel_down_400bp, so the step 3 run uses reference_shock_bps -400. Each priced index carries a caller-declared beta against that reference shock, and the step reports the incremental delta-NII from indices not moving in lockstep.
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: IRRBB NMD Shock and Basis Risk Check
